Windows раздаёт обновления другим компью: Windows shares updates with other computers over the internet
Включена «Оптимизация доставки» в режиме: “Delivery Optimization” is set to “local network and internet”: Windows hands out pieces of updates and apps to other people’s computers. The home upload channel is narrow, and when it is busy, game ping jumps. “Local network only” keeps sharing between your own devices and gives nothing to the internet.
Проводное подключение работает на скорос: The wired connection runs at 100 Mbit/s or lower
Современные сетевые карты и роутеры рабо: Modern network cards and routers run at 1 Gbit/s and up. 100 Mbit/s or less usually means a bad or damaged cable, a faulty connector or an old port. That is enough for the game itself, but under load the link fills up faster and ping rises.
Замените патч-корд на кабель категории 5: Replace the patch cable with a Cat 5e/6 cable and check the connectors.
Попробуйте другой порт роутера или комму: Try another router or switch port.
Если скорость не растёт — в свойствах ад: If the speed does not rise, choose “Auto Negotiation” under “Speed & Duplex” in the adapter properties.
При слабом сигнале адаптер понижает скор: With a weak signal the adapter lowers its speed and retransmits lost packets — hence ping spikes and a “rubbery” picture in online games. Move the PC closer to the router or put the router in the open, switch to the 5/6 GHz band, or better, use a cable.
Поставьте роутер ближе и выше, без стен: Put the router closer and higher, with no walls or metal in the way.
Подключитесь к сети 5 ГГц или 6 ГГц, есл: Connect to the 5 GHz or 6 GHz network if your router offers it.
For games an Ethernet cable is the most reliable.
«Оптимизация доставки» только в локально: Delivery Optimization on the local network only
Windows перестаёт раздавать обновления и: Windows stops handing out updates and apps to other people’s computers over the internet and does not occupy the upload channel — ping in games becomes steadier. Sharing between your own devices at home stays. Mode 1 (“local network only”).
Заменяет DNS-серверы на активных подключ: Replaces the DNS servers on active connections. A fast DNS speeds up logging in, finding a match and loading launchers. It does not affect ping during a match.
Куда связь быстрее и стабильнее, и какой: Where the connection is faster and steadier, and which DNS answers faster. Measurements only.
Время соединения, разброс и потери до об: Connection time, spread and loss to cloud regions where game servers often run
Быстрый DNS ускоряет вход в игру и поиск: A fast DNS speeds up logging in and finding a match. It does not affect the ping of the match itself.
Что ещё снижает пинг: кабель вместо Wi-F: What else lowers ping: a cable instead of Wi-Fi, background downloads closed, Delivery Optimization on the local network only (a finding in the analysis). Opti does not offer “TCP tweaks”: they have no measurable effect.
